note: Window: 8 calls Q2 FY25-Q1 FY27, all transcripts opened (company-hosted copies of the exchange filings where the NSE copy was not located). Rule 7 added Q4 FY24 (2024-05-17) and Q1 FY25 (2024-08-09) as originating calls for FY25 guidance and multi-year statements; N=10, weights 10..1 by position. Quotes were extracted via WebFetch in capped segments; joined fragments are marked '...'. Page refs may be ±1. Class 9: requests for guidance on years not yet guided (e.g. FY27 asked on Q3 FY25, Q4 FY25, Q1 FY26, Q3 FY26 calls) are treated as 'never guided', not refusals, and are not captured. Rule 6: no statutory impact statements arose from the calls. Reg. 30 stamp-duty demand (Jul 2026) ₹108.54 mn [amount unverified, media] ÷ FY26 consolidated PAT ₹51,235 mn = 0.21% < 1% → not captured. Not graded for lack of filed outcomes: quarterly other-expense run-rates, Sentynl FY26 break-even (Q3 FY25), Comfort Click/Amplitude EPS accretion, gRevlimid and Mirabegron product sales, Usnoflast Phase 2b start date (Q1 FY26), EM segment margin 23%+ (Q3 FY25), US base ≥ $1 bn ex-exceptionals (Q4 FY25). Key misses: CUTX-101 approval four quarters late; FY26 capex 43% above the ₹1,200 cr estimate; Desidustat China launch re-set. Watch: FY27 revenue guide softened in wording from 'high teens' to 'strong double-digit'; FY27 capex guide raised within weeks; opex run-rate guide stepped up three times; North America negative YoY in the last two quarters.
